cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a Three Kingdoms festival street — standing; a contemporary private overnight ferry cabin with a round window — she sits back after reaching for a folded blank timetable; a starship data archive — sets a cup down on the surface in front of her; a modern glass-walled office at dusk — sketches in a sketchbook and pencil; a hangar maintenance bay — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; a walled garden with a lotus pond — standing; a night river covered with floating paper lanterns — lifts a small hand lantern to chest height; a quiet modern seaside guesthouse bedroom with pale blue walls — she laughs softly at the distant cry of a gull while sitting up from a deep cushioned window seat; a hotel suite with a city view and an open suitcase — holds a book closed against her chest; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — sketches in a sketchbook and pencil; a sunny ranch — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a circus tent ring under a striped canopy — holds her keepsake at chest height; the moat path beneath the old Jingzhou city wall at dusk — standing
